threads.body: Removing the AI-attribution marker instruction makes the existing CI policy ineffective: `.github/workflows/ci.yml`’s `author-self-review` job fails PRs only when it finds the `<!-- I'm an AI agent!!! -->` / `# I'm an AI agent!!!` markers. Without a documented requirement to add the marker, AI-authored changes can bypass that check. Either keep this requirement (until CI is updated to enforce the policy another way) or update CI in the same PR.
